role: Director, Division of Transportation Planning and Programming, Florida Department of Transportation
summary: Ray G. L'Amoreaux, Director of the Division of Transportation Planning and Programming at the Florida Department of Transportation, endorsed the proposed actions in the draft EIS to preserve the environment. He noted that ORV operators had been reported cutting fences and accessing lands without proper driveways, creating environmental, drainage, erosion, and other control problems for his department's facilities. His letter expressed support for the regulatory measures proposed in the statement.

statement.opening_anchor:
Dear Mr. Spicer:

Subject:
U.S. Department of Interior - Eureau of Outdoor Recreation: Draft Environmental Impact Statement Pertaining to Use of Off-Road Vehicles on the
Public Lands (K14)

This agency has reviewed the subject proposal and endorses the actions proposed to preserve the environment.
statement.closing_anchor:
We appreciate the opportunity to review this proposal.

Very truly yours,
RAY G. K'AMORETHY, P.E., DIRECTOR DIVESTON OF PARITY ING AND PROGRAMMING
